entries.title: From a starter page to a working app
entries.text: The framework's starter page gives way to an item list, a login with registration and password reset, and an account page. Items open on their own detail page instead of an inline panel.

entries.title: Settings and activity
entries.text: Settings move out of the account page into their own tabbed page, and the feed is rebuilt as an activity page with filters.

entries.title: One list instead of three
entries.text: Drafts and the archive stop being separate pages and become filters on the item list.
